subject.title: Dashboard: chart widgets (line, bar, area, sparkline, gauge)

question: Should OpenClaw accept chart widgets as first-party bundled dashboard builtins through the linked dashboard PR path, or should charting remain a custom/external widget capability first?
rationale: The request is useful and has an implementation candidate, but it depends on an unsettled dashboard foundation and a maintainer choice about bundled builtin scope versus plugin/ClawHub distribution.

options.title: Sponsor After Prerequisites
options.body: Keep this issue open and consider chart builtins after the dashboard foundation is accepted, with the linked PR repaired or narrowed before merge.

options.title: Route To Custom Widgets
options.body: Use the dashboard custom-widget path or ClawHub/plugin distribution for charts if maintainers do not want more bundled builtins yet.

options.title: Defer With Roadmap
options.body: Leave the chart item paused under the broader roadmap until the Wave 2 dashboard direction is accepted, narrowed, or rejected.

recommendation.title: Sponsor After Prerequisites
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and consider chart builtins after the dashboard foundation is accepted, with the linked PR repaired or narrowed before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main history on the Control UI plugin-tab seam and adjacent product/security boundary this feature builds on.
